Background

Engineer by training, project controls by trade

I started in industrial engineering, then moved into project controls: tracking portfolios, reconciling financial data, and reporting to stakeholders. Along the way I've picked up data tools, automation, and applied AI, from fraud-detection models to small AI tools I actually use myself, and I use them to make that work faster and clearer.

At CIBC I tracked progress and reconciled month-end costs across a project portfolio valued at over $1M, reporting to 11+ stakeholders under real deadlines. I pick up new tools fast, going from MATLAB and Simulink one year to Python and applied ML the next. I'm also open to relocating for the right opportunity.
